description: The bar chart illustrates “Popularity” values for three knowledge domains (Movies, Songs, Basketball) across three LLMs (Llama3, Qwen2, ChatGPT), separating samples by answer/accuracy condition as indicated in the caption (Pop_GT and Pop_Ge for incorrectly answered samples, and Pop_GT/Pop_Ge for correctly answered samples). The horizontal axis contains the categorical domains in left-to-right order Movies, Songs, Basketball, and the vertical axis is labeled “Popularity” with a linear numeric scale spanning roughly 20 to 220, with regularly spaced tick labels at 20, 60, 100, 140, 180, and 220. Within each domain, bars are arranged in three color-coded model blocks—Llama3 in blue, Qwen2 in red, and ChatGPT in yellow—and each model block contains three adjacent bars distinguished by fill style: a patterned bar for “Acc=0 & GT Ans,” a diagonally hatched bar for “Acc=0 & Gene Ans,” and a plain/solid bar for “Acc=1 & GT Ans” (as shown in the legend). In Movies, Llama3’s three bars are approximately in the mid‑20s (Acc=0 & GT), mid‑30s (Acc=0 & Gene), and around 40 (Acc=1 & GT); Qwen2’s are roughly high‑20s, about 40, and mid‑40s; ChatGPT’s are roughly mid‑20s, about 30, and mid‑30s. In Songs, Llama3’s bars are approximately near 58 (Acc=0 & GT), about 48–50 (Acc=0 & Gene), and around 70–75 (Acc=1 & GT); Qwen2’s are around the high‑50s, mid‑60s, and about mid‑80s; ChatGPT’s are around the mid‑40s, low‑50s, and roughly low‑70s. In Basketball, Llama3’s bars are approximately about 100 (Acc=0 & GT), about 155 (Acc=0 & Gene), and around 180 (Acc=1 & GT); Qwen2’s are about 100, around 190, and near 210–215; ChatGPT’s are about 100, around 170–175, and around 140. The categories are not displayed as sorted by magnitude (they follow the domain order), and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the consistent use of color for model and patterning for condition.
